title: Switch MAM Allocation Method on Active Group
precondition: MAM group active with 10 accounts; manager changes method from PBB to PBE.
steps: 1. Manager switches allocation mode to Proportional by Equity (PBE).2. Submit update when zero trades are open.
expected: Allocation engine updates configuration; subsequent orders apportioned by live equity; audit log recorded.
coverage_note: Balance/equity sizing on current MAM tested; immutable configuration audit trail not inspected.
